escena: SCENE (cinematic still, an Efeonce studio at blue hour, thin haze, warm-neutral skin tones but a cool frame): Karo, wearing the ROYAL-BLUE EFEONCE HOODIE, stands at a long dark walnut table, framed from the waist up, body centred at about 60 % of the frame width, camera about two meters away at chest height, 85mm. MOMENT: caught mid-explanation, the instant she sets down the last of five real GREEN apples (crisp bright green skin, like Granny Smith) in a row on the table — the apples are arranged in a descending line from large to small like the steps of a marketing funnel, each one a step of a simple lesson; her other hand is open in a small explaining gesture toward the row, and she looks down at the apples with a warm, engaged smile, not at the lens. The fifth and smallest apple, the one she is placing, is lit by a single narrow beam of azure-blue (#0375DB) light from above, the only coloured light in the scene; the other four green apples sit in soft neutral light. Behind her, far and out of focus, a large dark wall with a few faint chalk-like hand-drawn lines, unreadable. No readable text anywhere, no logos of any other brand, no printed papers, no laptops, no mugs, no plants. The LEFT 30% of the frame is calm dark studio with only faint haze. COMPOSITION FOR A WEBSITE MENU (native to its frame): this vertical photo sits in the right column of a full-screen menu whose dark panel overlaps its LEFT third with a large curved corner at the top; so the SUBJECT and everything that carries the idea sits in the CENTRE-RIGHT of the frame, and the left third is calm continuation of the same scene, never empty and never a flat slab.
